# Repo-owned cmrc snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [vector-of-bool/cmrc](https://github.com/vector-of-bool/cmrc) at commit `952ffddba731fc110bd50409e8d2b8a06abbd237`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 17 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original MIT `LICENSE.txt` is retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
